title: 環境噪音屏障設計
summary: 本課以「從聲能、頻率與繞射幾何到屏障插入損失驗證」為主軸，依序處理聲源盤查與分貝加總、距離衰減與聲源幾何、頂部繞射與路徑差、板材穿透與開口漏聲、背景聲與效果上限。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Connect acoustic energy, frequency and diffraction geometry with verified barrier insertion loss, progressing through Source inventory and decibel addition, Distance loss and source geometry, Top-edge diffraction and path difference, Panel transmission and opening leakage, Background sound and performance floor. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.titleEn: Field insertion loss: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 現地插入損失 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Field insertion loss and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 屏障前後都用同一接收點並用參考麥克風校正聲源差異，將天氣變化列入紀錄。 插入損失比較同一接收點與相同聲源、氣象基準的前後差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the same receiver before and after, a reference microphone for source changes and a weather record. Insertion loss compares before and after at the same receiver with matched source and meteorological conditions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：同條件屏障前 Lbefore=72 dB；屏障後 Lafter=64 dB。公式 IL=Lbefore-Lafter，計算得 8 dB。適用邊界：背景、交通量與量測條件已匹配；不是聲壓振幅百分比。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Matched before-barrier level Lbefore=72 dB; after level Lafter=64 dB. Formula IL=Lbefore-Lafter gives 8 dB. Applicability: Matched background, traffic and measurement conditions; this is not a pressure-amplitude percentage.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩個互不相關聲源 L1=60 dB、L2=60 dB。公式 L=10*log10(10^(L1/10)+10^(L2/10))，計算得 63.0103 dB。適用邊界：相同頻帶、時間與加權的互不相關聲源。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Two uncorrelated sources L1=60 dB, L2=60 dB. Formula L=10*log10(10^(L1/10)+10^(L2/10)) gives 63.0103 dB. Applicability: Uncorrelated sources with the same band, duration and weighting.
